system_boundary.description: An external, reviewed laboratory recirculation loop used to characterize micro-/nanobubble conditioning and textile cleaning without integrating a generator into a domestic washer.
excludes: ozone plasma solvent and ultrasound treatments

control_arms.configuration: Declared detergent and conventional mixing with no MNB generator or recirculation module.
MNB-conditioned liquor with generator, pump, heater and controls separately metered.
Generator off with the same recirculation path, pump, pressure drop and operating duration as C1.
Conventional reference with a predeclared reduced detergent dose and no MNB.
MNB candidate using the exact reduced detergent dose declared for C3.
MNB candidate with predeclared reduced mechanical mixing, with mechanical action measured.

decision_hypotheses: Explore at least 10 percent lower complete-loop electrical energy per kg accepted textile at matched cleaning, rinse and fabric care.
Alternatively explore at least 20 percent lower detergent mass at the same accepted outcome without a resource or fabric-care penalty.
Alternatively explore at least 10 percent shorter treatment time at the same accepted outcome without increased total energy.

sources.scope_note: Two textile substrates and five stains; 5.6-fold oil-removal result is experimental context only, not a household product claim.
Review of MNB cleaning mechanisms and application constraints, not household appliance qualification.
Household ultrasonic comparison used to bound ultrasound as an adjunct rather than a replacement.
Bench/pilot wastewater flotation evidence; not a compact household washing loop result.
